paper.title: EcoAgent: An Efficient Device-Cloud Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Mobile Automation
paper.central_claim: 提出闭环端云协同多智能体 EcoAgent：云端 Planning Agent 以 Dual-ReACT 生成带“期望”的逐步计划并在失败时基于记忆/反思重规划；端侧 Execution Agent 执行、端侧 Observation Agent（含 Pre-Understanding 文本压缩）校验并向云端反馈；在 AndroidWorld 上达到与全云端 agent 相当的任务成功率，同时降低云端资源消耗与响应延迟、保护隐私。

preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores. GPT-4o cloud planner (Dual-ReACT: describe initial screenshot, plan steps each with an expected outcome) + device-side executor (ShowUI-2B or OS-Atlas-Pro-4B) + device-side observer (Qwen2-VL-2B) that checks each post-action screen against the expectation and returns 50-150-token text summaries; failure triggers memory/reflection replanning. AndroidWorld (116 tasks, programmatic checks), single run: 25.6/27.6% vs M3A 28.4, but Agent S2 54.3 and UGround-7B 44.0 (GPT-4o cloud/open-loop) are far higher, so 'matches fully cloud-based agents' holds only against M3A. Cloud calls/tokens, uplink kB and per-step latency are measured with device models on an RTX 3090; step caps are not stated; the initial screenshot is uploaded to the cloud. Cumulative ablation executor -> +planner -> +observer on two executors. Applicable: gui C10/C15/C17/C18; E02, E16, E17, E19, E21.
agreed_items_review: Agreed items G=2, E.measurement=3, E.causality=2, E.holdout=1, E.statistics=1, claim_type system_method, evidence_level online, claim_support scoped were re-checked: all stand. Both seats correctly scope the 'matches cloud agents' claim to M3A only.

gap.author_gap: 云端多智能体延迟/成本高且有隐私风险；直接的端云协作多为开环（单向指令，云端仍需截图验证）（C001/C002）。
gap.checked_gap: 成本/延迟缺口是真实的；开环近邻（UGround+M3A）确实需要云端验证，表中成本最高（C017）。但：端侧单模型 V-Droid(59.5) 在更低延迟下远超 EcoAgent（C011），削弱了“端侧不会规划”这一前提；云端多智能体 Agent S2(54.3) 同样远高（C010）。隐私缺口仅以“上行字节数”侧面度量，无泄露测度（C031）。

ancestors: AppAgent/MobileAgent（云端单智能体+辅助检测）

gap.residue: 端侧小模型的接地能力是主要失败来源（10/20）；验证准确率未知；真机延迟未测。
gap.stakes: 若验证器不准，闭环既不省钱也不稳；隐私主张未验证则不应写入结论。
gap.method_response: 把校验下沉到端侧（期望比对），用文本压缩替换原图传输，云端只在失败时介入。
gap.remaining_gap: 验证器准确率；与云端校验的同 SR 成本对比；隐私泄露度量；真机延迟；与 V-Droid 等强端侧模型的组合。

assessment.evidence_level_note: AndroidWorld programmatic checkers; single benchmark/platform, no held-out environment -> online, not transfer.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported, single AndroidWorld run: EcoAgent (GPT-4o planner + 2-4B device models) reaches 25.6/27.6% SR, close to M3A (28.4) but far below Agent S2 (54.3) and UGround-7B (44.0), while using about 1.5-1.9 cloud calls and 3.2-3.5K cloud tokens per task and 120 kB uplink; adding the observer/feedback loop raises SR on both executors (7.0->15.5->25.6; 4.3->19.0->27.6).
not_supported: Matching fully cloud-based agents in general (Agent S2/UGround-7B much higher)
Privacy protection (initial screenshot uploaded; no leakage measure)
Separate contributions of Dual-ReACT vs ReACT and Pre-Understanding vs raw screenshots
unresolved: Step caps for EcoAgent and baselines
Provenance/settings of baseline SR and cost numbers
SR values (25.6, 7.0) not integer multiples of 1/116

G.reason: Latency/cost/privacy limits of cloud and open-loop systems are real and partly quantified, but the residual is weakened by device-only V-Droid (59.5, 3.0 s) and cloud Agent S2 (54.3), and the privacy gap is argued, not measured.

M.reason: Expectation-driven device-side checking with cloud escalation only on failure is a concrete mechanism, but its key assumptions are untested: a 2B general VLM judging 'screen meets expectation', text summaries sufficing for replanning, and summaries protecting privacy while the initial screenshot is uploaded. No distinguishing test against cloud-side verification.

X.reason: Algorithm, all four prompts (Tables 7-10), action space incl. DeleteText, model choices and the surrogate deployment are given, so the replanning loop and its stop condition are reconstructable. Missing: step caps, replan limits, handling of observer misjudgements, baseline settings.

E.measurement.reason: Primary SR comes from AndroidWorld programmatic checkers; cloud cost measured as calls/tokens/uplink. Deductions: latency per step on an RTX 3090, baseline number provenance unstated, some SR values not multiples of 1/116, privacy unmeasured.

E.causality.reason: Cumulative role-addition ablation on two executors supports the feedback package as a whole; Dual-ReACT vs plain ReACT, Pre-Understanding vs raw-screen upload and device- vs cloud-side verification are not isolated; baseline comparisons mix planners, executors and caps.

E.holdout.reason: Single benchmark, no dev/test separation for prompts, no other benchmark or real device.

E.statistics.reason: Task denominator and a 20-task failure audit given; single run, no spread; 27.6 vs 28.4 is within known AndroidWorld run-to-run variation.

E.cost.reason: Cost is the central claim and is measured several ways (MC/MT, uplink kB, FLOPs, per-step latency), but budget fairness is not established: step caps are unstated for all methods, the cost table omits the strongest baselines (Agent S2, V-Droid), cost per success is not given, latency is per step on surrogate hardware, and a stated ratio (6.5x MC) does not follow from Table 2.
